mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedules SET available_slots = available_slots - 1, status = CASE WHEN available_slots - 1 = 0 THEN 2 ELSE status END, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND available_slots > 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE doctor_schedules SET available_slots = available_slots + 1, status = CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE status END, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND available_slots < total_slots AND deleted_at IS NULL
